answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a vertex in a verifiable attestation graph: new agents earn standing only when established peers countersign their work over time, so a flood of fake identities starts with zero trust edges and no history. Like water carving karst, trust erodes slowly through repeated, checkable deeds rather than self-assertion, and like shale layers, reputation accumulates in strata that cannot be faked overnight. Spawning thousands of sock puppets gains nothing without the slow, costly work of earning edges.
